title: Fragrance Giants Fined Over $600M in EU and U.K. for Antitrust Violations
summary: Firmenich, Givaudan and IFF face major penalties for exchanging sensitive information and breaching competition laws.

extraction.key_fact: 대형 향료 회사들이 민감한 정보를 교환해 경쟁법을 어긴 혐의로 유럽연합과 영국에서 제재를 받았다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Firmenich, Givaudan and IFF face major penalties for exchanging sensitive information and breaching competition laws.
